items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: And I remember, Joe Clayton's buddy.

ctx.x: What about if people would ask you that you didn't have a race before you played anyway?

Well, they have a few things you'd ask for that we didn't have. We had really everything in the album. Russ, we had it from Red Allen or we had it from Pops. You had to read a big book. Yeah, he had a hell of a book. Russ had music, no. You didn't play many heads at all? No, we didn't. We had played most arrangements. I'll tell you one time, yeah, we were in Chicago at the Grand Terrace for two weeks. Fox had the job. And I remember, Joe Clayton's buddy. And you remember? My name is the shame. They had an arguing…
Oh, that was funny. He could make the people like anything, did he?
